name: Buffer
whatYouLose: Approved API access to every network (some charge for API use or require app review)
Maintenance every time a platform changes its API
Mobile apps and team approval flows
prompt:
Build a social post scheduler, a Buffer replacement for one person.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, a cron worker (node-cron), server-rendered UI.
Features:
- Connect accounts via OAuth for Bluesky (AT Protocol), Mastodon and LinkedIn; X optional if I provide API keys.
- Compose once, customize per network, character counters per network, image upload.
- Queue with posting slots per weekday; drag to reorder the queue; calendar view.
- Worker publishes due posts, retries with backoff and records the post URL or error.
- Link shortening optional; basic stats where the APIs expose them.
Done when: a post scheduled 2 minutes out is published to Bluesky and Mastodon.
notes: Open APIs (Bluesky, Mastodon) are trivial. Closed ones cost money or review time, which is what Buffer absorbs for you.
